definition: A dedicated action spent performing battlefield engineering rather than ordinary movement or combat.
mechanical_role: Action economy for construction, clearance, demolition or preparation.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A dedicated engineering action used to prepare or execute destruction of a terrain feature, obstacle or structure.
mechanical_role: Separates destructive engineering from general engineering activity.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A terrain feature or structure that has been pre-rigged for later destruction.
mechanical_role: Creates a delayed or conditional terrain-destruction state.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules; MMP Where Eagles Dare Exclusive Rules

definition: An engineering task that neutralises previously prepared demolition charges before they can be triggered.
mechanical_role: Counter-engineering against prepared terrain destruction.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A rating describing how concentrated a minefield is and therefore how difficult or dangerous it is to cross.
mechanical_role: Controls minefield passage difficulty without changing its physical footprint.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A minefield whose mines are laid on or near the surface and may therefore be easier to detect or traverse than concealed mines.
mechanical_role: Minefield subtype affecting detection or passage difficulty.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A false minefield represented like a real one until interaction reveals that it contains no effective mines.
mechanical_role: Area-denial bluff and information-control mechanic.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules; MMP Tactical Combat Series Rules

definition: The procedure or test used when a unit attempts to move through an uncleared minefield.
mechanical_role: Resolves risk while crossing an intact mine obstacle.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A recognised route through a minefield that improves subsequent passage without removing the minefield as a whole.
mechanical_role: Creates a reusable route through an otherwise persistent obstacle.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: An action dedicated to opening a usable route through a minefield, wire or comparable obstacle.
mechanical_role: Creates passage through an obstacle at an action or tempo cost.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A deliberate attempt to cross an intact minefield without first creating a safe breach.
mechanical_role: Trades speed or necessity against minefield risk.
source_family: MMP Tactical Combat Series Rules

definition: A minefield containing an established safe or reduced-risk route while the surrounding mine obstacle remains effective.
mechanical_role: Persistent obstacle state after successful breaching.
source_family: MMP Tactical Combat Series Rules

definition: The direction through which an obstacle breach is usable, limiting passage to the route actually opened.
mechanical_role: Preserves the geometry of a cleared lane rather than clearing an entire terrain area.
source_family: MMP Tactical Combat Series Rules

definition: Opening a route through an obstacle with specialist equipment or vehicles rather than dismounted manual effort.
mechanical_role: Provides faster or safer obstacle reduction through specialist assets.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules; MMP Tactical Combat Series Rules

definition: A terrain feature or breach that constrains movement and creates additional exposure or congestion as units pass through it.
mechanical_role: Models congestion and vulnerability at restricted passages.
source_family: MMP Tactical Combat Series v4.02 Rules

definition: A persistent opening created through a wire obstacle, often associated with a particular crossing point or direction.
mechanical_role: Converts an impassable or costly obstacle segment into a usable passage.
source_family: MMP Brazen Chariots Rules

definition: The preparation step that changes a bridge or structure from intact to ready for a later demolition attempt.
mechanical_role: Separates preparation from triggering, allowing interruption and counterplay.
source_family: MMP Where Eagles Dare Exclusive Rules

definition: A demolition attempt triggered when enemy movement threatens a prepared structure or crossing.
mechanical_role: Turns prepared destruction into a reaction to enemy approach.
source_family: MMP Where Eagles Dare Exclusive Rules

definition: An engineering process that restores a destroyed or unusable crossing to a usable state.
mechanical_role: Reverses terrain destruction and restores mobility.
source_family: MMP Where Eagles Dare Exclusive Rules

definition: A specialist unit that deploys a temporary bridge or crossing aid onto the battlefield.
mechanical_role: Creates a crossing through otherwise restrictive terrain.
source_family: World at War 85 Core Rules 2.1

definition: A temporary floating bridge assembled by engineers to carry units across a water obstacle.
mechanical_role: Creates a constructed water crossing with an explicit engineering time or capacity cost.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules

definition: A transport formation carrying the modular components and equipment required to construct a temporary bridge.
mechanical_role: Makes bridging capability dependent on transported engineering matériel.
source_family: Billy Yank 10mm ACW Rules

definition: The process of degrading an obstacle sufficiently to permit easier movement without necessarily removing it completely.
mechanical_role: Supports multi-stage obstacle states rather than binary present/absent terrain.
source_family: Fire and Fury Battlefront Engineering Playtest Rules; MMP Tactical Combat Series Rules
